name: torture
description: Adversarial original/replacement pairs for the meaning-preservation gate, each with the outcome a reader should get. Refusal pairs change meaning in a way some guard must catch; `surfaced` pairs are ordinary clarity edits that must still reach the writer, so the corpus cannot be satisfied by refusing everything. Six of them passed the gate before 2026-09-02 and are the reason the guards in tests/gate-fixes.test.mjs exist.
policy: Each pair is put through analyzeSentence with an engine that returns `replacement` verbatim and a verifier that always answers 'still implied' — the most permissive configuration the product ships. A pair recorded as refused is therefore refused deterministically, whatever the verifier would say. `reason` is the label the pipeline gives; a change to it is a relabelling to review, not a regression.

pairs.source: The auditor reviewed the vendor's controls.
pairs.replacement: The vendor reviewed the auditor's controls.
pairs.note: The pair from the review: the sentence now says the opposite.

pairs.source: The supplier invoiced the contractor.
pairs.replacement: The contractor invoiced the supplier.

pairs.source: The landlord sued the tenant.
pairs.replacement: The tenant sued the landlord.
pairs.note: Who sued whom is the whole content of the sentence.

pairs.source: The buyer indemnifies the seller.
pairs.replacement: The seller indemnifies the buyer.

pairs.source: The parent company guarantees the subsidiary's debts.
pairs.replacement: The subsidiary guarantees the parent company's debts.
pairs.note: Reverses who is on the hook.

pairs.source: More than 40% of the tests failed.
pairs.replacement: 40% of the tests failed.

pairs.source: Less than half the team replied.
pairs.replacement: Half the team replied.

pairs.source: Fewer than ten tests failed.
pairs.replacement: Ten tests failed.

pairs.source: Up to twelve users can join the session.
pairs.replacement: Twelve users can join the session.

pairs.source: No more than three retries are allowed.
pairs.replacement: Three retries are allowed.

pairs.replacement: More than 40% of the tests failed.

pairs.source: At least five reviewers must approve the change.
pairs.replacement: Five reviewers must approve the change.
pairs.note: A minimum became an exact count.

pairs.source: We were more than happy to provide assistance with the request.
pairs.replacement: We were more than happy to assist with the request.
pairs.note: 'more than happy' bounds nothing, so the bound guard must stay silent while the nominalization is unpacked.

pairs.source: The decision is up to the steering group at this point in time.
pairs.replacement: The decision is up to the steering group now.
pairs.note: 'up to the steering group' bounds nothing.

pairs.source: Run the migration before the deploy starts.

pairs.source: Check the log when the meeting starts.
pairs.replacement: Check the log before the meeting starts.

pairs.replacement: Log the result once the job runs.

pairs.source: Archive the build after the release ships.
pairs.replacement: Archive the build once the release ships.
pairs.note: After becomes at the moment of.

pairs.source: The alert fires before the threshold is reached.
pairs.replacement: The alert fires after the threshold is reached.

pairs.source: The job runs once a day and the report is generated at the end of the day.
pairs.replacement: The job runs once a day and the report is generated at day's end.
pairs.note: 'once a day' is a frequency, not a subordinator.

pairs.source: Hold the release until Friday.
pairs.replacement: Hold the release Friday.

pairs.replacement: The job runs if the queue is empty.

pairs.replacement: She used her laptop.

pairs.source: Only the lead may approve it.
pairs.replacement: The lead may approve it.

pairs.replacement: I will not revise it.

pairs.replacement: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.

pairs.source: The outage was caused by the alert.

pairs.source: He counted the coins twice before locking the drawer.
pairs.replacement: He counted the coins before locking the drawer.
pairs.note: How many times is not implied by anything left.

pairs.source: The service is fast and reliable under load.

pairs.source: Send the report before Thursday.
